decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: The Comprehensive Guide to Factors Impacting Your Mineral Rights Valuation
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 30c3639a637223247d3c1e36250837f3f2f76adf6c282886f31e6c0560744208; all 8 declared sources passed live access review.

MRX claims remain bounded to its current FAQ, booking page, and methodology; EIA series remain dated, source-specific public data; Texas regulator records remain identifier-specific query slices; and IRS claims remain general disposition and record distinctions.

The article uses no fabricated owners, buyers, deeds, prices, factor weights, multiples, acreage, ownership decimals, production, reserves, development events, tax results, offers, testimonials, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, engineering, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Published DCF Methodology (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology identifies production history, decline context, operator and development evidence, royalty terms, commodity assumptions, discounting, title and acreage, and offer terms as dated inputs to a directional range with assumptions stated.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the methodology for an owner-facing factor-to-range traceability framework while preserving directional, stated-assumption, offer-separation, and professional boundaries; it does not calculate a property-specific value, establish universal weights, prove title or reserves, promise an outcome, or recommend a transaction.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Frequently Asked Questions (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX FAQ states that its review is a free, no-obligation directional underwriter assessment, not a certified valuation, and states its no-pressure and potential-buyer disclosure boundaries.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only for MRX’s current first-party review policy, directional limits, and provider-interest disclosure; it does not promise a result, interpret a separate agreement, or treat a directional range as a buyer offer.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Book a Free Underwriter Review (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX booking page describes a free, confidential review path with no card and no obligation while preserving separate intake and later decision steps.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the booking page only for the current first-party intake description; it does not promise eligibility, completion timing, a range, an offer, payment, sale, or closing.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Natural Gas Data (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current EIA natural-gas data directory publishes price, production, reserves, supply, and other series with different subjects, frequencies, dates, units, and geographic scopes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the directory only to require a named series, retrieval date, frequency, units, geography, and property bridge; it does not treat an EIA series as the realized price, property production history, reserves, forecast, or value of a specific mineral interest.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Petroleum and Other Liquids Data (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current EIA petroleum data directory publishes price, production, reserves, supply, stocks, and other series with different subjects, frequencies, dates, units, and geographic scopes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the directory only to distinguish a dated public market or production series from a property-specific realized price, cash flow, forecast, reserves conclusion, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil and Gas Production Data (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas production-data page describes compilations and summaries of production information reported by Texas operators and provides query and download routes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only as an example of a dated state-regulator production source that must be matched to the subject property; it does not treat a row as proof of ownership, royalty entitlement, reserves, future production, development, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, About Oil and Gas Data Queries (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas query guide explains that each query is one slice of the larger oil-and-gas system and distinguishes wellbores, completions, leases or gas-well identifiers, permits, operator records, and related searches.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the guide only to require identifier-aware matching and to prevent different regulator records from being treated as interchangeable proof; it makes no property-specific regulatory, title, production, or valuation conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Internal Revenue Service, Publication 544, Sales and Other Dispositions of Assets (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: IRS Publication 544 explains that gain or loss and tax treatment for a sale or other disposition depend on the property and transaction facts and on adjusted basis and amount realized.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the publication only to require preservation of disposition- and basis-relevant records and a transaction-specific tax handoff; it does not classify the owner’s asset, calculate basis, gain, loss, liability, choose a form or election, or state an owner-specific tax result.
